style: Eigene Symbole für sakrale und infernale Magie im Oblivion-Stil

images.name: Sakrale Magie
images.prompt: Create an original Sakrale Magie magic-path icon matching the painted Oblivion-style bronze frame of the reference. Replace its central glyph with: two ivory wings curving upward around a small radiant golden sun, with one thin gold halo above. A simple unified emblem of a divine blessing, warm gold and pearl highlights. Keep the emblem bold and readable at small icon size, with no lettering. Isolated emblem on transparent background.

images.name: Infernale Magie
images.prompt: Create an original Infernale Magie magic-path icon matching the painted Oblivion-style bronze frame of the reference. Replace its central glyph with: a bold crimson flame between two upward-curving ivory horns, joined at the base by one antique bronze chain link. A compact infernal pact seal, deep garnet red and amber fire. Keep the emblem bold and readable at small icon size, with no lettering. Isolated emblem on transparent background.
